probes.name: P-12.1
probes.subject: tools/measure.py
probes.note: PLAN-0125 Step 3, AC-12. A battery's coverage denominator is its claim_sources MODULE, not a PLAN step — so the recipe's probes live here, with the module whose claims they cover, while plan-0125-step3.json covers the contract module. Written as a DUPLICATE rather than a dropped invocation: dropping one would also destroy the recent_commits value and redden three claims at once, whereas emitting the head block twice moves only the count. blocks reads 3 while both values stay exactly right. It is also why the test reads the raw block list instead of a metric-keyed dict — a dict would have collapsed the duplicate to two keys and stayed green.
